summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39 completed: upstream solver parity corpus committed verbatim as a test fixture, permanent parity tests (scorer replay + solver selection + corpus metadata) and PaletteAPIClient wire-contract pinning tests written, corpus consumption documented under docs/. bin/lint --staged is green, but the Swift build/test portion was skipped because no Swift toolchain exists in this container; swift test must be run on macOS (pre-commit/ bin/lint) before the implementation PR lands. Generated-client migration (swift-openapi-generator) and the README section are deferred to the implementation run per phase rules. Parity pre-verification: the exact test logic was mirrored over the committed fixture and agrees with the corpus on all 12 scenarios (score tables, selections, errors, tied indices, tie_broke including the null-when-no-selection encoding).

acceptance_criteria.reason: No PR is opened in this tests-writing phase (Paid publishes the tests-only draft).
